title: Chapter 2 full-island PixelLab growth experiment
timestampBasis: Captured immediately after the accepted animation job completed; PixelLab did not return per-job timestamps.
selectionRationale: Seed 27303 best preserved the full-island question: an organic rounded rocky coast, a clearly planted ancient hero-tree root, layered asymmetric canopy, and dense readable ground detail. The accepted animation grows land before trunk, branches/canopy, and final ground detail without replacing the final mature identity.

ownerLookVerdict.note: Machine and author inspection curate this witness but do not sign the owner-held LOOK verdict.

islandGroundAnchor.meaning: alpha-weighted horizontal centre of the lowest three visible parcel rows and the lowest visible parcel y

treeRoot.meaning: mature trunk-to-ground centre; roots extend outward below this socket

registration.normalizationPolicy: Translate each decoded RGBA frame at author/import time so its lower-island anchor is exactly (128,239); reject non-256 RGBA frames and any translation that clips visible pixels.

capabilityCountSeam.reason: The cheapest bounded monotonic seam is to reveal or tint a capped set of app-owned foliage clusters at the six registered canopy sockets after their supporting canopy exists. It preserves the PixelLab base, root, footprint, frame family, and painter order without generating a sheet per capability count.
capabilityCountSeam.adoptionRisk: Overlay art must be visually matched against the owner-held LOOK; a bounded registered canopy-variant set is the fallback only if socket overlays visibly break the PixelLab style.

budgets.runtimeDecodeWorstCase: 2.25 MiB if all nine frames are decoded simultaneously; the contact sheet is inspection-only and must not be imported by runtime.

startState.source: Selected mature palette and declared island anchor
startState.recipe: Author a tiny isometric grass/soil wedge with a two-leaf shoot on transparency; the lower parcel point is normalized to the mature island anchor before acceptance.

prompts.mature: Complete floating story island asset for a Chapter 2 growth animation. One compact oval land parcel in a low isometric / 2.5D view, entirely visible with generous transparent margin. A single ancient hero tree grows from the exact centre-back of the parcel; thick warm-brown trunk, clearly visible roots gripping the soil, parent-first readable branch structure, broad asymmetrical emerald canopy with warm lime highlights. The whole island is one coherent painter-friendly silhouette: grassy top, warm ochre soil and a thin rocky coast rim, tiny flowers, mushrooms, two or three small rocks, fern and grass tufts distributed across the ground without hiding the roots. Whimsical premium storybook pixel art, hand-authored 16-bit sensibility, restrained natural palette, selective dark outline, crisp clusters, detailed pixel shading, no anti-aliased vector look. Composition invariant: parcel ellipse centred at x=128, ground anchor at x=128 y=218, tree root at x=128 y=172, mature footprint fully inside x=30..226 and y=18..226. No water, no sky, no background, no cast shadow, no UI, no labels, no text, no border, no other trees, no characters, no animals, no buildings. Transparent background.
prompts.maskedRepair: Remove the small conifer tree completely. Continue the same grassy island ground through this area and replace it with one low fern, a tiny mossy rock and a few grass blades. No tree, no trunk, no tall plant. Preserve every pixel outside the masked area and preserve transparent background.
prompts.wholeImageRepair: Preserve this exact 256x256 transparent pixel-art island composition, camera, palette, parcel coastline, ancient central hero tree, roots, canopy, rocks, flowers, mushrooms, lighting and pixel style. Make only this semantic revision: remove both small conifer trees on the left and right ground; replace them with low ferns, tiny mossy rocks and grass tufts, clearly shorter than the hero tree roots. Keep exactly one tree, the ancient central hero tree. Keep the island bottom point, parcel footprint, tree root and mature canopy planted at their current pixels. Transparent background, no water, no shadow, no UI, no text.
prompts.startTrialA: First planted state for an in-place growth animation toward the reference island. Preserve the same 256x256 transparent canvas, low-isometric camera, storybook pixel style, palette, lighting direction and exact world registration. At the mature island's exact bottom anchor x=128 y=238, show only a very small central wedge of warm soil and grass beginning to surface, with a tiny cracked seed and one two-leaf shoot planted on the future hero-tree root line x=128. The land is sparse and low, no mature island footprint yet; no trunk, no branches, no canopy, no conifers, no water, no sky, no shadow, no UI, no text. Do not centre-scale or float the start; the visible soil touches the same bottom anchor as the future island and leaves generous transparency.
prompts.startTrialB: First planted state for an in-place growth animation toward the reference island. Preserve the same 256x256 transparent canvas, low-isometric camera, storybook pixel style, palette, lighting direction and exact world registration. At the mature island's exact bottom anchor x=128 y=238, show only a very small central wedge of warm soil and grass beginning to surface, with a tiny cracked seed and one two-leaf shoot planted on the future hero-tree root line x=128. The land is sparse and low, no mature island footprint yet; no trunk, no branches, no canopy, no conifers, no water, no sky, no shadow, no UI, no text. Do not centre-scale or float the start; the visible soil touches the same bottom anchor as the future island and leaves generous transparency. Make the start especially sparse: only a thumb-sized oval dirt/grass parcel and a 4-pixel shoot, with the same planted bottom point.
prompts.animationAction: Grow this one planted story island in place from the tiny soil wedge into the supplied mature island. Keep the transparent 256x256 canvas and the exact island bottom anchor fixed at x=128 y=239 in every frame; do not translate, float, bounce, rotate or centre-scale the whole scene. Choreography is causal and ordered: first the oval rocky land/coast parcel emerges laterally and upward from the fixed bottom anchor while staying planted; then the central shoot rises into a trunk from the same x=128 root line; major branches extend parent-first from visible forks; canopy clusters accumulate only after their supporting branches; flowers, grass, mushrooms and rocks settle last. Preserve low-isometric camera and painter order. No water, no sky, no background, no cast shadow, no UI, no text. The last supplied frame is authoritative and must be reached exactly.

inspection.acceptedVisualSummary: A coherent growing island reaches the exact selected mature frame. The land expands from a normalized lower anchor; the shoot/trunk precedes supported canopy; dense ground detail appears after the structural tree.
remainingWeaknesses: The selected mature frame includes two small conifers despite the mature prompt asking for no other trees; masked and whole-image repairs were visibly weaker and therefore rejected.
Frame 00 is deliberately sparse and locally authored; its tiny scale should be checked at the smallest supported mobile viewport.
Frames 06 and 07 change mostly in ground detail, so the app's timing should not over-hold both.
Generated interpolation is discrete rather than a continuous topology rig; app-owned easing and holds must carry the intended rhythm.
Capability-count socket overlays are assessed but not owner-LOOK-approved.
